description: Client-only. Place the held block INTO the given cell so that it gets the properties you ask for (facing, half, axis, hinge, type...): the bridge tries every click within reach (which neighbour and face, which spot on it, which way to turn) against the block's own placement rules and uses one that gives that state, turning the player first. Properties left out are free. Answers with NO_SUPPORT (nothing next to the cell to place against), OUT_OF_REACH, OCCUPIED, CANNOT_PLACE, or NO_CLICK_GIVES_THAT_STATE with 'reachable' (the states possible from here: walk around or add a support block); on an integrated server 'matches' says whether the placed block has the wanted properties. Hold the item first (select_hotbar_slot); a torch item places wall_torch on walls. A stair climbs toward its facing (a roof's stairs face the ridge).

state.description: Wanted block with the properties that matter, e.g. "oak_stairs[facing=north,half=top]" or "wall_torch[facing=east]".

name: place_block_at
title: Place held block with a given state
